items.name: hook8_1
items.direction: Narrate for a premium documentary YouTube channel about money and history. The narrator is a deep, warm, confident storyteller with a hint of mystery, energetic and punchy, never slow, never announcer-like. These are separate short lines for YouTube Shorts: read each one as its own complete take, with the same voice, energy and loudness every time, and leave a clear one-second pause between lines. Natural emphasis on dates and numbers; questions end with a curious lift. Say the amount exactly as written: three point three billion pounds.
lines: Your guaranteed return hides one question. In 1992, it cost Britain 3.3 billion pounds. Who's defending it?
